choose.when: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id as showId, title, venue_name as venueName, poster_url as posterUrl, start_date as startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%' || #{genre} || '%' ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
choose.otherwise: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id as showId, title, venue_name as venueName, poster_url as posterUrl, start_date as startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%대중음악%' ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id as showId, title, venue_name as venueName, poster_url as posterUrl, start_date as startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%뮤지컬%' ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 8 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id as showId, title, venue_name as venueName, poster_url as posterUrl, start_date as startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%연극%' ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 7

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id AS showId, title, venue_name AS venueName, poster_url AS posterUrl, start_date AS startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%대중음악%' AND start_date > TO_DATE('2026-04-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY start_date ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id AS showId, title, venue_name AS venueName, poster_url AS posterUrl, start_date AS startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%뮤지컬%' AND start_date > TO_DATE('2026-04-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY start_date ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT show_id AS showId, title, venue_name AS venueName, poster_url AS posterUrl, start_date AS startDate FROM show_tbl WHERE genre LIKE '%연극%' AND start_date > TO_DATE('2026-04-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY start_date ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.title AS title, s.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_date AS startDate, s.genre AS genre, s.poster_url AS posterUrl FROM show_tbl s INNER JOIN showDetail_tbl d ON s.show_id = d.show_id WHERE 1=1 AND s.start_date > TO_DATE('2026-04-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND s.show_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT show_id FROM schedule_tbl )
AND s.genre = '대중음악'
AND s.genre = '뮤지컬'
AND s.genre = '연극'
AND s.genre = '대중음악'
ORDER BY s.start_date ASC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= 20 ) WHERE rnum >= 1

SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.title, s.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate, s.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.genre, d.age_limit AS ageLimit, d.ticket_price AS ticketPrice, d.cast_info AS castInfo, d.styurl, d.runtime FROM show_tbl s LEFT OUTER JOIN showDetail_tbl d ON s.show_id = d.show_id WHERE s.show_id = #{showId}

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, show_id as showId, play_date as playDate FROM schedule_tbl WHERE show_id = #{showId} AND TO_CHAR(play_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{playDate} ORDER BY start_time
SELECT show_id AS showId, title, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, venue_name AS venueName, poster_url AS posterUrl, genre FROM show_tbl WHERE genre = #{genre} ORDER BY show_id DESC

SELECT po.order_id AS orderId, po.user_id AS userId, TO_CHAR(po.approved_at, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS approvedAt, COUNT(tp.seat_id) AS quantity, tp.ticket_status AS status,
s.show_id AS showId, s.title AS title, s.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate,
sch.play_date AS playDate,
CASE WHEN sch.play_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '가능' ELSE '불가' END AS cancelAvailable
FROM payment_order po JOIN ticket_payment_tbl tp ON po.order_id = tp.order_id JOIN show_tbl s ON tp.show_id = s.show_id JOIN schedule_tbl sch ON tp.schedule_id = sch.schedule_id WHERE po.user_id = #{userId} AND tp.ticket_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY po.order_id, po.user_id, po.approved_at, tp.ticket_status, s.show_id, s.title, s.poster_url, s.venue_name, s.start_date, s.end_date, sch.play_date ORDER BY po.approved_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) FROM payment_order po JOIN ticket_payment_tbl tp ON po.order_id = tp.order_id WHERE po.user_id = #{userId} AND tp.ticket_status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT schedule_id, show_id, TO_CHAR(play_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS play_date, TO_CHAR(play_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS play_day, start_time FROM schedule_tbl WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
